title: The Contrary wind in the sails
subtitle: 战争和平 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 战争和平（历史社会与文化·战争与和平）
meta: 主题语境：战争和平（历史社会与文化·战争与和平）　|　核心词汇：contrary　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 contrary 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 the doctor wrote of ① a contrary wind in the sails in the chart, and everybody in the clinic said at once that it was ② more contrary than the one named there the year before. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the doctor, who never explained anything, had done it with great care and gone home; it was the contrary ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most contrary wind in the sails anybody in the clinic had ever seen, or so the chart for January 1960 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too contrary to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the patient who had come to help; the contrary ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the bandage at the far bed, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a contrary view of the matter, and said that no patient in his right mind would call it ⑥ as contrary as the view of the matter they had once had in the old clinic. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was contrary or not, and he said so.

By 1973 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the chart. What the line asked for was ⑦ something contrary, and nothing besides. The patient from the next clinic called the whole plan ⑧ quite contrary; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the chart kept the names of the contrary ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1976, on the same day, she wrote of another contrary wind in the sails in the same chart, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ more contrary than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most contrary view of the matter in the whole clinic, she said in 1978, was the one she could never quite name; the contrary ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 相反（前置定语 a contrary wind in the sails：1966 年大夫在病历里记下的那件相反的风）
B. adj. 相反／逆向（比较级 more contrary than：文中两处，一处比迎面而来的风，一处比预想）
C. adj. 相反／逆向（最高级 the most contrary：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 相反（表语 too contrary to do：母亲觉得它太相反，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 逆向（前置定语 a contrary view of the matter：叔叔把整件事称作一桩逆向的看法）
F. adj. 逆向（同级比较 as contrary as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩对事情的看法相比）
G. adj. 逆向（后置定语 something contrary：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 逆向（受程度副词修饰 quite contrary：那位病人的评价）

items.q: a contrary wind in the sails
the most contrary wind in the sails anybody
a contrary view of the matter
The most contrary view of the matter in

answers.why: contrary 意为“相反”，1966 年大夫在病历里记下的是“一件相反的风”，此处作前置定语 a contrary wind in the sails。
contrary 意为“相反”，此处用比较级 more contrary than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
contrary 意为“相反”，病历上 一月 那行字说它是卫生所里最相反的一件，故用最高级 the most contrary wind in the sails。
contrary 意为“相反”，母亲认为这件东西“太相反了，谁也用不上”，too contrary to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
contrary 意为“逆向”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩逆向的看法”，此处作前置定语 a contrary view of the matter。
contrary 意为“逆向”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩对事情的看法一样逆向”，同级比较用 as contrary as。
contrary 意为“逆向”，病历上那半行字要的是“逆向的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something contrary。
contrary 意为“逆向”，邻卫生所来的那位病人认为这套计划“相当逆向”，quite 修饰原级 contrary。
contrary 意为“逆向”，1976 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要逆向”，故用比较级 more contrary than。
contrary 意为“逆向”，母亲 1978 年说的是“整个卫生所里最逆向的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most contrary view of the matter。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1966 年，大夫在病历里记下了一件相反的风。（a contrary wind in the sails）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更相反。（more contrary than …）
母亲觉得它太相反，谁也用不上。（too contrary to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩逆向的看法。（a contrary view of the matter）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩对事情的看法一样逆向。（as contrary as …）
到了 1973 年，病历上只剩半行字：要的是一件逆向的东西。（something contrary）
answers: In 1966 the doctor wrote of a contrary wind in the sails in the chart.
Everybody said it was more contrary than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too contrary to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a contrary view of the matter.
He said nobody would call it as contrary as the view of the matter they had once had.
By 1973 the chart asked for nothing but something contrary.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 contrary 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1966 the doctor wrote of a contrary wind in the sails in the chart, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most contrary wind in the sails in the clinic, or so the chart says.
My mother thought it too contrary to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a contrary view of the matter, and nobody argued with him.
The patient from the next clinic called the plan quite contrary, and everybody laughed.
The contrary ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
